Definition: a prolonged form of a primary verb (which is used as an alternative in most of the tenses); to give (used in a very wide application, properly, or by implication, literally or figuratively; greatly modified by the connection):--adventure, bestow, bring forth, commit, deliver (up), give, grant, hinder, make, minister, number, offer, have power, put, receive, set, shew, smite (+ with the hand), strike (+ with the palm of the hand), suffer, take, utter, yield.
BiblicalUsage: To give is the simplest verb in the Bible and the deepest, and it runs from the Father's gift of His Son to the daily bread we ask for. God gave His only begotten Son, the Father gives the Holy Spirit to them that ask Him, and every good gift comes down from the Father of lights.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe giving is the nature of God. He gives His Son, He gives His Spirit, He gives daily bread, and the whole gospel is the story of a God who gives until there is nothing left to give.
